best_period_window: Late March–early June & mid September–early November
gateway_airport: XRY — Jerez de la Frontera, 1 h 15 to Grazalema; AGP Málaga is the bigger-choice alternative at 2 h to Grazalema, 1 h 20 to Ronda

title: Four Walled Villages of the Alsace Wine Road
best_period_window: Start on a Thursday so Ribeauvillé's Saturday market and Colmar's covered market both fall inside the week; September brings the harvest and October the colour.
gateway_airport: Basel-Mulhouse EuroAirport (BSL/MLH)

title: The Périgord Noir, Slowly
best_period_window: Truffle and foie gras season runs November to March, outside this window; these dates instead catch the walnut harvest and the start of autumn markets without July's crowds.
gateway_airport: Bergerac Dordogne Périgord (EGC)

title: Pelion Kalderimia: Mansions, Plane Trees and the Little Train
sub_region: Thessaly — Mount Pelion & the Pagasetic Gulf
best_period_window: Mid-May–late June & mid-September–early November
gateway_airport: SKG Thessaloniki — 2 h 30 min drive to Makrinitsa; VOL Nea Anchialos (seasonal) 45 min; ATH Athens 3 h 30 min, or 3 h by train to Volos with a change at Larissa

title: The Bend and the Hills: Szentendre, Esztergom and the Palóc Villages
sub_region: Danube Bend (Dunakanyar) & the Cserhát Hills, Nógrád County
best_period_window: late April to early June, and the whole of September into mid-October
gateway_airport: Budapest Liszt Ferenc (BUD). The **HÉV H5** suburban railway from Batthyány tér reaches Szentendre in about 40 min: a 500 HUF Budapest single plus a suburban supplementary ticket of about 450 HUF for the Békásmegyer–Szentendre section, roughly 950 HUF (~€2.40) each way. A party is better off with MÁV's HÉV *kirándulójegy*, 6,200 HUF for unlimited Békásmegyer–Szentendre travel for up to ten people in a day (2026 tariff). From Day 4, a small hire car picked up in Vác or Budapest makes the Cserhát practical.

title: Umbrian Hill Towns: Spello, Bevagna & the Sagrantino Hills
sub_region: Valle Umbra — Spello, Bevagna, Montefalco, Trevi
best_period_window: Late April–mid June & mid September–late October
gateway_airport: PEG — Perugia San Francesco d'Assisi, 27 km / 30 min to Spello; FCO Rome is the fallback, 2 h 15 by car

title: Curonian Spit: Nida, Juodkrantė & the Dune Villages
sub_region: Neringa / Klaipėda, Curonian Spit UNESCO World Heritage Site
best_period_window: Late May to late September. July–August is warm but busy; the first three weeks of September are the local secret — warm lagoon, empty streets, migrating birds

title: Little Switzerland and the Northern Castles
best_period_window: Whit Tuesday brings Echternach's hopping procession (26 May in 2026); October adds the Vianden nut market and beech colour in the gorges.
gateway_airport: Luxembourg (LUX)

title: Kurzeme Slow Week: Kuldīga, Sabile & Talsi
best_period_window: Mid-May to September. Late May for the lamprey and fish-jumping season at the Venta rapids; late July for the Sabile wine festival; September for mushrooms and empty guesthouses

title: The Round Fort and the Casa Mare: Seven Slow Days in Small-Town Moldova
sub_region: The Middle Dniester, Soroca, and the Orhei Codru
best_period_window: the second half of May into mid-June, then all of September
gateway_airport: Chișinău International (KIV), 13 km southeast of the centre. Hire a car at the airport — rural buses run to school and market timetables and will not fit this route. Trolleybus 30 into town is 7 MDL; a Yandex Go or Bolt car lands around 160 MDL (€8). Iași, in Romania, is 3 h by road.

title: Ohrid, Bitola & Kruševo: Lake Light and Balkan Corso
best_period_window: Mid May–late June & September–mid October
gateway_airport: OHD — Ohrid St Paul the Apostle, 10 km / 15 min to the old town; SKP Skopje is the bigger hub, 2 h 45 by road or a €10–€15 shared transfer

title: The Hanseatic IJssel — Deventer, Zutphen, Zwolle, Hattem
best_period_window: The Deventer Boekenmarkt falls on the first Sunday of August; December brings the Dickens Festijn and much colder river wind.
gateway_airport: Amsterdam (AMS)

title: Loess, Arcades and Onion Bread: A Slow Week in Lubelskie's Small Towns
sub_region: Lubelskie, the Vistula bend and the Zamość–Roztocze borderland
best_period_window: the second half of May into mid-June — lilac and rapeseed, ravines dry enough to walk, everything open, nothing full
gateway_airport: Warsaw Chopin (WAW) or Modlin (WMI), then 160 km / 2 h 15 by car to Kazimierz Dolny. Car-free: PKP Intercity Warszawa–Lublin in about 2 h 15, or Warszawa–Puławy Miasto in 1 h 45, then bus or taxi the last 14 km to Kazimierz. Lublin Airport (LUZ) at Świdnik has a thin route list — check before you build the week around it.

title: Alentejo's Walled Villages: Monsaraz, Estremoz & the Serra de São Mamede
sub_region: Alentejo — Alqueva, Alto Alentejo & the marble towns
best_period_window: March–mid June & mid September–early November
gateway_airport: LIS — Lisbon Humberto Delgado, 1 h 50 to Monsaraz; Badajoz (BJZ) in Spain is 1 h from Marvão if the schedule suits

title: Blue Gates and Fortified Churches: A Slow Week Through Saxon Transylvania
sub_region: Târnava Mare & the Hârtibaciu Plateau — Saxon Transylvania (Siebenbürgen)
best_period_window: the second half of May into June (hay meadows in flower), and late September
gateway_airport: Fly to Sibiu (SBZ) or Târgu Mureș (TGM); Cluj (CLJ) is the bigger hub, 2h30 by car. Rail: Bucharest–Sighișoara ~5h on the CFR IR line, Brașov–Sighișoara ~2h30. Hire the car in Sibiu and drop it there on Day 7.

title: Silver, Wood and Limewood: A Slow Week in Banská Štiavnica and the Spiš Towns
best_period_window: the second half of September — warm days, tajchy still swimmable in the first week, no coach parties in Levoča
gateway_airport: Fly Bratislava (BTS) or Vienna (VIE, 70 km); return from Košice (KSC). Rail alternative: Bratislava–Hronská Dúbrava–Banská Štiavnica, then IC to Poprad and Spišská Nová Ves.

title: San Marino & the Montefeltro: Towers, Truffles and Block-Printed Linen
sub_region: San Marino & the Emilia-Romagna / Marche border
best_period_window: Late April–June & September–early November (October for the truffle fair)
gateway_airport: RMI — Rimini Federico Fellini, 30 min to San Marino; BLQ Bologna is the bigger hub, 1 h 40 by car or 1 h by train to Rimini plus a 50 min bus

title: Albanian Alps to the Riviera
sub_region: Shkodër, Theth, Vlorë & the Albanian Riviera
best_period_window: Late May–late June & mid-September–early October
gateway_airport: TIA — Tirana International "Nënë Tereza"; 95 km / 1 h 40 to Shkodër on SH1

title: Grossglockner, Timmelsjoch and the Tyrolean Toll Roads
sub_region: Hohe Tauern, Zillertal, Ötztal and the Silvretta
best_period_window: The high toll roads open between late May and mid-June and shut with the first serious snowfall, usually late October.
gateway_airport: Innsbruck (INN)

title: Orpheus Country: A Rhodope and Rila Driving Loop from Plovdiv to Sofia
best_period_window: late May to late June for green meadows and full waterfalls, then mid-September to mid-October for colour and empty roads
gateway_airport: Fly into Sofia (SOF), 1 h 45 by A1 to Plovdiv, or Plovdiv (PDV) direct. Rail Sofia–Plovdiv 2 h. Drop the car in Sofia.
currency: Euro (EUR) — sole legal tender since 1 February 2026; mandatory dual BGN display ended 8 August 2026

title: Passes and Valleys — Bernina to the Gotthard
best_period_window: The San Bernardino and Gotthard Tremola pass roads are normally open only from late May or June to October; confirm current status before booking.
gateway_airport: Zürich (ZRH)

title: The Pass Quadrilateral — Furka, Grimsel, Susten, Nufenen
sub_region: Bernese Oberland, Uri and Goms (Upper Valais)
best_period_window: The Nufenen is usually the last of the four to open, often not until mid-June.
gateway_airport: Zürich (ZRH)

title: Bohemia by Car — Spa Colonnades, Ore Mountains and Sandstone
sub_region: West Bohemia, Krušné hory and the Elbe sandstone
best_period_window: The Krušné hory ridge road is snow-cleared but slow from November to March; the sandstone gorge boats run April to October only.
basecamps: Karlovy Vary, Mezní Louka and Kutná Hora
gateway_airport: Prague (PRG)

title: The B500 — Schwarzwaldhochstrasse, Panoramastrasse and Baden Wine
sub_region: Schwarzwald and the Baden wine terraces, Baden-Württemberg
best_period_window: The B500 ridge is open all year but drifts and freezing fog close sections in midwinter; late September brings the wine harvest and the clearest air.
basecamps: Baden-Baden, Triberg and Freiburg im Breisgau
gateway_airport: Karlsruhe/Baden-Baden (FKB) or Basel–Mulhouse–Freiburg (BSL/MLH/EAP)

title: Andalucía: Ronda, the Alpujarras & Cabo de Gata
sub_region: Andalucía — Serranía de Ronda, Sierra Nevada's southern slope and Almería
best_period_window: April–early June & mid-September–early November
gateway_airport: AGP — Málaga Costa del Sol; 100 km / 1 h 40 to Ronda via the A-357 and A-367, or 1 h 25 on the A-397

title: Faroe Islands Subsea Loop: Eighteen Islands, Six Tunnels
best_period_window: May to September for open roads, ferries and puffins; late September for autumn light; winter driving is feasible but daylight is short and mountain roads close in gales

title: Route des Grandes Alpes — Lake Geneva to the Mediterranean
best_period_window: Iseran and Galibier normally open between late May and mid-June and close with the first heavy snow in late October; the full route is only continuous in that window.
basecamps: Thonon-les-Bains to Menton, one night per stage
gateway_airport: Genève (GVA), out from Nice (NCE)

title: Peloponnese Loop: Nafplio, the Mani & Olympia
sub_region: Peloponnese — Argolid, Arcadia, Laconia, Messenia and Elis
best_period_window: Late April–early June & mid-September–late October
gateway_airport: ATH — Athens Eleftherios Venizelos; 120 km / 1 h 30 to Nafplio via the A6, A8 and A7

title: The Western Arc: Seven Days from the Danube Bend to the Őrség
sub_region: Transdanubia — Danube Bend, Bakony, Balaton Uplands, Őrség, Fertő
best_period_window: the second half of May and the first three weeks of September — Balaton traffic gone, Őrség green, Badacsony cellars open
gateway_airport: Budapest Ferenc Liszt (BUD). Collect the car at the airport, not downtown — you avoid the city entirely on day 1 via the M0 and M2.

title: Wild Atlantic Way: Dingle, Iveragh & the Burren
sub_region: County Kerry & County Clare, Wild Atlantic Way
best_period_window: May–June and September for long light, open attractions and manageable traffic; July–August is peak and the coach volume on Slea Head and the Ring of Kerry is significant
languages: English|Irish — the Dingle peninsula west of Dingle town is a Gaeltacht where Irish is the daily language

title: Sicily Grand Circuit: Palermo, Etna & the Val di Noto
sub_region: Sicily — Palermo, Etna, the Ionian coast and the Val di Noto
best_period_window: Late April–early June & mid-September–October
gateway_airport: PMO — Palermo Falcone Borsellino; 35 km / 40 min to central Palermo on the A29. Return from CTA Catania is 30 min from Taormina

title: The Rhine Alpine Triangle — Vaduz, the Silvretta and Graubünden
sub_region: Alpine Rhine valley, Vorarlberg and Graubünden
best_period_window: The Silvretta Hochalpenstrasse and Furkajoch open in June and close in late October; everything below 1,700 m works from May.
gateway_airport: Zürich (ZRH)

title: The Grand Duchy Loop — Éislek Ridges to Moselle Terraces
best_period_window: Late September puts the Moselle harvest and the Éislek beech colour in the same week.
gateway_airport: Luxembourg (LUX)

title: Three Corniches and the Road to Turini
best_period_window: Avoid the Grand Prix build, which closes central Monaco streets from early April to late June.
gateway_airport: Nice Côte d'Azur (NCE)

title: The Grand Loop: Cliff Monasteries, the Prut and the Deep South by Car
sub_region: Dniester cliffs, the northern Prut, Ștefan Vodă and Gagauzia
best_period_window: the second half of September — harvest in the vineyards, dry clay tracks, and the Prut floodplain still green
gateway_airport: Chișinău International (KIV). Collect the car at the airport; Moldovan-plated rentals need no road vignette. Iași (IAS) in Romania is a viable alternative entry, 2 h 30 from Chișinău, but a cross-border hire costs more.

title: Kotor to Sarajevo via the Tara Canyon
sub_region: Boka Kotorska, Durmitor, the Piva canyon and Sutjeska
best_period_window: Mid-June–early July & September (Sedlo Pass open, Durmitor snow-free)
gateway_airport: TIV — Tivat; 22 km / 35 min to Kotor. Return from SJJ Sarajevo, 12 km from the centre

title: Driving the Defences — Delta Works to the Afsluitdijk
sub_region: Zeeland Delta, IJsselmeer, Frisian & Groningen Wadden coast
best_period_window: Late September brings the annual closing test of the Maeslantkering and the first proper Wadden light.
gateway_airport: Amsterdam Schiphol (AMS)

title: Lofoten E10: Fishing Villages & Arctic Light
best_period_window: Midnight sun roughly 26 May–17 July; late August–September for autumn colour, aurora and half the traffic; February–March for aurora with drivable roads

title: The Eagles' Nests: Limestone Castles from Kraków to the Silesian Coalfield
sub_region: Kraków–Częstochowa Upland (Jura Krakowsko-Częstochowska) and Upper Silesia
best_period_window: mid-May to mid-June — long light on white limestone, castles open, Jasna Góra between the big pilgrimages
gateway_airport: Kraków–Balice (KRK); SKA1 train to Kraków Główny, 20 PLN, ~20 min. Katowice (KTW) is the alternative, 1 h 20 from Kraków. Rental desks at both airports.

title: The N2 Middle: Torre, Schist Villages and the Road South
sub_region: Beira Interior, Serra da Estrela & the Alentejo Guadiana
best_period_window: Mid-May–late June & mid-September–late October
gateway_airport: OPO Porto — 1 h 30 min to Viseu; LIS Lisbon 2 h 20 min to Viseu; exit from FAO Faro, 1 h 30 min from Mértola

title: Two Roads Over the Carpathians: The Transfăgărășan and Transalpina Loop from Sibiu
best_period_window: late June to mid-September, when both DN7C and DN67C are certain to be open end to end
gateway_airport: Sibiu International (SBZ), 5 km out; Cluj (CLJ) 3 h; Bucharest Otopeni (OTP) 4 h. CFR rail from Brașov 2 h 40.

title: Julian Alps Passes: Vršič, Predel & Mangart
sub_region: Gorenjska & Primorska — Upper Sava, Trenta and the Soča Valley
best_period_window: Mid-June–early July & September–early October (all three passes reliably open)
gateway_airport: LJU — Ljubljana Jože Pučnik; 62 km / 50 min to Kranjska Gora via A2 and Route 201

title: Nosferatu to the Silver Town: An Orava, Tatra and Spiš Castle Loop
sub_region: Orava, the Tatras, Spiš and the Slovak Karst
best_period_window: the second half of September — clear air over the Orava, castles still open, no Tatra traffic
gateway_airport: Fly Poprad-Tatry (TAT) or Košice (KSC) and rent there; return the car in Bratislava (one-way fee applies). Alternatively start and end in Bratislava and add 340 km to reach Orava.

title: Andorra High Route: Comapedrosa, Juclà and the Madriu Valley
sub_region: Vall del Madriu-Perafita-Claror & Parc Natural Comunal de les Valls del Comapedrosa
best_period_window: Late June–early October, with the staffed refuge window roughly 1 June–12 October
gateway_airport: TLS Toulouse-Blagnac, 3 h to La Massana by bus or car; BCN Barcelona 3 h 15 min; LEU Andorra-La Seu d'Urgell 40 min

title: The Berliner Höhenweg — Zillertal Alps Hut Chain
best_period_window: The Mörchenscharte and Lapenscharte hold old snow into early July; go after mid-July for the cleanest rock on the cabled sections.
gateway_airport: Innsbruck (INN)

title: The Stubai Höhenweg Hut Circuit
best_period_window: The Peiljoch and Niederl saddles hold hard snow into early July; late September brings the first hut closures.
gateway_airport: Innsbruck (INN)

title: Sutjeska and Zelengora: Maglić, Perućica and the Via Dinarica White Trail
sub_region: Sutjeska National Park, Zelengora & the upper Drina — Republika Srpska
best_period_window: Mid-June–early October, with late June for the Zelengora wildflowers and September for stable rock on Maglić
gateway_airport: SJJ Sarajevo, 2 h 45 min to Tjentište via Foča; TGD Podgorica 2 h 30 min; TIV Tivat 3 h

title: The GR57 Ourthe Valley Walking Week
best_period_window: Summer school holidays (July–August) bring the kayak and campsite crowds to the river villages; late spring and September keep the valley quiet.
gateway_airport: Brussels (BRU)

title: Marble and Granite: A Pirin Hut-to-Hut Week from Bansko
sub_region: Pirin National Park (Северен и Централен Пирин)
best_period_window: the second half of September — snow gone from Koncheto, huts half-empty, storm frequency dropping
gateway_airport: Sofia (SOF) airport, then a direct bus to Bansko from Sofia Central Bus Station (2 h 45–3 h 15) or the narrow-gauge Septemvri–Dobrinishte railway, the slowest and best-looking train in the Balkans. Plovdiv (PDV) is a 3 h 30 alternative.
currency: Euro (EUR) — sole legal tender since 1 February 2026; mandatory dual BGN display ended 8 August 2026

title: Berner Oberland Hut Chain — Kandersteg to Grindelwald
best_period_window: The Hohtürli approach and Sefinenfurgge can hold hard snow into July; the cable-secured Chindbetti step near Hohtürli is safest dry.
gateway_airport: Zürich (ZRH)

title: Walker's Haute Route Finale — Val d'Hérens to Zermatt
sub_region: Valais Alps, Val d'Hérens to Mattertal
best_period_window: The Forcletta and Augstbordpass cols hold snow into early July in a heavy winter; the Europaweg's suspension bridge is closed in high wind, so build a spare day near the end.
gateway_airport: Geneva (GVA)

title: Bohemian Switzerland — A Sandstone Walking Week
sub_region: České Švýcarsko, Ústí nad Labem Region
best_period_window: July–August bring crowds and timed-entry queues at Pravčická brána; the gorge boats stop running in poor water levels, usually checked daily in high summer.
gateway_airport: Prague (PRG)

title: The Heilbronner Weg Hut Chain — Allgäu High Route
best_period_window: Snow can sit in the Bockkarscharte and on the shaded ledges of the Heilbronner Weg into early July; the traverse is safest from mid-July.
gateway_airport: Memmingen (FMM)

title: Ordesa y Monte Perdido: Góriz, the Fajas and the GR-11
sub_region: Aragonese Pyrenees — Ordesa y Monte Perdido National Park, Sobrarbe
best_period_window: Mid-July–late September, with early September the best combination of clear rock and thin crowds
gateway_airport: ZAZ Zaragoza, 3 h 15 min to Torla; TLS Toulouse 3 h 30 min via the Bielsa tunnel; BCN Barcelona 4 h 15 min

title: Hetta–Pallas Wilderness Traverse
best_period_window: Mid-June to early October. Late June–July for midnight sun and mosquitoes; **early to mid-September for ruska**, the Lapland autumn colour, which is the single best week of the year here

title: The GR54 — Refuges of the Écrins Amphitheatre
sub_region: Massif des Écrins, Oisans, Hautes-Alpes / Isère
best_period_window: The Col d'Arsine holds snow into early July; this itinerary covers the Vénéon and Villar-d'Arêne sections of the full GR54 Tour de l'Oisans, which takes 9–11 days end to end.
gateway_airport: Grenoble (GNB) or Lyon (LYS)

title: Mount Olympus Refuges: Petrostrouga, the Muses Plateau and Mytikas
sub_region: Central Macedonia & Thessaly — Olympus National Park, Pieria
best_period_window: Mid-June–early October, with mid-September the best mix of stable rock and empty refuges
gateway_airport: SKG Thessaloniki Makedonia, 1 h 10 min to Litochoro; ATH Athens 4 h 30 min by car or 4 h by train to Litochoro station

title: Alta Via 1 in Seven Days: Braies to the Civetta Wall
sub_region: Dolomiti Bellunesi & Ampezzane — Fanes-Sennes-Braies, Lagazuoi, Civetta
best_period_window: Late June–mid-September, with 10 July–10 September the fully staffed window
gateway_airport: VCE Venice Marco Polo, 2 h 40 min to Lago di Braies via Dobbiaco; INN Innsbruck 2 h; TSF Treviso 2 h 45 min

title: Liechtenstein Panorama — Malbun, Fürstensteig and the Rätikon Rim
best_period_window: The Naafkopf ridge and Pfälzerhütte approach can hold snow into June; the Fürstensteig is best walked dry, after a settled spell.
gateway_airport: Zürich (ZRH)

title: The Escapardenne Eisleck Trail — Kautenbach to La Roche
sub_region: Éislek plateau, northern Luxembourg and Belgian Ardennes
best_period_window: The Éislek's schist plateau holds water after rain; late spring and early autumn give firmer paths and cooler walking than midsummer.
gateway_airport: Luxembourg (LUX)

title: Jotunheimen Hut-to-Hut: Besseggen to Fannaråken
best_period_window: The staffed hut season runs roughly late June to mid-September, and that is the window. Early July still has snow on the high traverses; late August and the first week of September give the most stable conditions

title: Orla Perć and the Five Lakes: A Polish Tatra Hut Week from Zakopane
sub_region: Tatry Wysokie & Tatry Zachodnie, Tatrzański Park Narodowy
best_period_window: the first three weeks of September — Orla Perć dry and empty, hut floors free, Morskie Oko without the queue
gateway_airport: Kraków Balice (KRK), then 2 h by FlixBus/Szwagropol to Zakopane, or the PKP IC "Tatry" train 3 h 30.

title: The Red Stripe: Seven Days on the Făgăraș Ridge, Suru to Sâmbăta
sub_region: Munții Făgăraș, Southern Carpathians (Sibiu, Argeș and Brașov counties)
best_period_window: the last week of August and the first three weeks of September — snow gone from the couloirs, storms less frequent, springs still running
gateway_airport: Sibiu (SBZ) or Bucharest (OTP, 4 h by train to Sibiu/Brașov). Local train or taxi Sibiu → Turnu Roșu, 30 km. Exit by taxi from Mănăstirea Brâncoveanu to Făgăraș or Victoria, then rail to Brașov.

title: Kungsleden North: Abisko to Nikkaluokta
sub_region: Lapland, Norrbotten — Abisko and Kebnekaise massif
best_period_window: Late June to mid-September, matching the STF staffed-hut season and the boat services. July has mosquitoes and midnight sun; the first half of September has autumn colour, no insects and the first frosts

title: Triglav Hut-to-Hut: Vrata, Kredarica and the Seven Lakes
sub_region: Julian Alps & Triglav National Park — Vrata, Kredarica, Triglavska jezera, Bohinj
best_period_window: Mid-July–mid-September, with the huts fully staffed roughly 20 June–30 September
gateway_airport: LJU Ljubljana Jože Pučnik, 55 min to Mojstrana; KLU Klagenfurt 1 h 40 min; TRS Trieste 2 h

title: Chains and Chata Beds: A High Tatras Hut-to-Hut Week from Starý Smokovec
best_period_window: the first three weeks of September — high routes still open, huts quieter, stable anticyclonic weather
gateway_airport: Poprad-Tatry (TAT) airport, 15 min to Poprad station; Košice (KSC) 1 h 40. Then the **TEŽ** electric railway to Starý Smokovec (35 min).

title: Peaks of the Balkans: Rugova, Doberdol and the Three-Border Passes
sub_region: Prokletije / Accursed Mountains — Rugova, Valbona, Theth & Plav
best_period_window: Mid-June–late September, with the sweet spot 10 July–10 September
gateway_airport: PRN Pristina Adem Jashari, 1 h 40 min drive to Peja/Peć; TIA Tirana 3 h 30 min to Valbona via the Koman ferry or the Kukës motorway

title: Grüner Veltliner and the Wachau Terraces
best_period_window: September and early October bring the Marillenernte's tail end and the first Sturm; May is blossom season on the terraces.
basecamps: Krems an der Donau and Dürnstein
gateway_airport: Vienna (VIE)

title: Lambic, Geuze and the Trappist Table
best_period_window: Even-numbered years bring the biennial Toer de Geuze open-cellar weekend, usually the first weekend of May — build the trip around it if the calendar allows.
gateway_airport: Brussels (BRU)

title: Mavrud and the Broad-Leaved Vine: Thrace to Melnik in Harvest Week
sub_region: Thracian Lowlands PGI and the Struma Valley PGI
best_period_window: mid-September to mid-October — *grozdober*, the harvest, when the crush pads are running and the estates are at their most open
gateway_airport: Plovdiv (PDV) has limited flights; Sofia (SOF) is the practical arrival, 145 km and 1 h 45 from Plovdiv on the Trakia motorway, or 2 h by fast train. Melnik is 180 km south of Sofia on the E79 Struma motorway, 2 h 15.
currency: Euro (EUR) — sole legal tender since 1 February 2026; mandatory dual BGN display ended 8 August 2026

title: Fendant, Raclette and the Valais Vineyard Trail
best_period_window: September and October bring the vendanges and full raclette season; May and June give clear bisses paths and the same growers pouring the previous vintage.
gateway_airport: Geneva (GVA)

title: Moravian Cellars and Bohemian Lager
sub_region: South Moravia, Plzeň Region and Prague
best_period_window: September through mid-October is harvest (vinobraní) season in Moravia; cellars are busiest and most alive but book further ahead.
gateway_airport: Prague (PRG)

title: Baden Wine and the Black Forest Table
best_period_window: Early April brings almond blossom to the Kaiserstuhl; late September and October bring harvest and the first Straußwirtschaften of the year.
gateway_airport: EuroAirport Basel-Mulhouse-Freiburg (EAP)

title: Riesling on the Mosel Slate
best_period_window: Late September and October bring the Weinfeste and full cellars; May and June give quiet tasting rooms and the same growers pouring last year's vintage.
gateway_airport: Frankfurt-Hahn (HHN)

title: The Sherry Triangle: Solera, Tabanco & the Bajo de Guía
sub_region: Marco de Jerez — Jerez de la Frontera, El Puerto de Santa María, Sanlúcar de Barrameda & Cádiz
best_period_window: Late February–early June & late September–early November
gateway_airport: XRY Jerez, 15 min taxi to Jerez centre; SVQ Seville 1 h 15 min by car, 1 h 10 m by train

title: The Côte d'Or, Climat by Climat
sub_region: Côte de Nuits and Côte de Beaune, Burgundy
best_period_window: Late September to mid-October overlaps harvest (vendange); domaines are busiest and some close tasting rooms for a week at a time.
gateway_airport: Lyon-Saint-Exupéry (LYS)

title: Champagne, Chalk to Cork
sub_region: Reims, Épernay, Côte des Blancs and Côte des Bar
best_period_window: Late September into October is harvest (vendange) — the region is at its most alive, but book grande marque cellar tours further ahead.
gateway_airport: Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG)

title: Crete End to End: Horta, Graviera & the Raki Fires
best_period_window: Late April–early June & late September–early November
gateway_airport: CHQ Chania, 20 min to Chania old town; HER Heraklion, 25 min to Archanes; 2 h 30 min CHQ–HER by road

title: Istria in Truffle Season: Motovun Forest, Malvazija & the World's Best Oil
sub_region: Central Istria, the Mirna valley & the west coast
best_period_window: Mid-September–late November for white truffle; late April–June for a quieter, cheaper version
gateway_airport: PUY Pula, 50 min to Motovun; TRS Trieste 1 h 30 min; ZAG Zagreb 3 h; VCE Venice 2 h 45 min

title: Bull's Blood and Noble Rot: Seven Days Between Eger and Tokaj
sub_region: Eger and the Bükk foothills, then Tokaj-Hegyalja on the Bodrog
best_period_window: the last week of September through the third week of October — Eger's reds are in, Tokaj's aszú pickers are out
gateway_airport: Budapest Liszt Ferenc (BUD) then hire car; Eger is 130 km northeast, about 1 h 50 on the M3. Rail: Budapest Keleti–Eger, roughly 2 h with a change at Füzesabony. Leaving from Tokaj, Debrecen (DEB) is ~100 km and often cheaper than driving back to Budapest.

title: West Cork Larder: Ballymaloe to Skibbereen
sub_region: County Cork — East Cork, Kinsale and West Cork
best_period_window: May to October. June for the first of the season's produce and long evenings; September–October for shellfish, apples and the West Cork food festivals

title: Sangiovese Spine: Chianti Classico, Montalcino & the Pecorino Hills
sub_region: Chianti Classico, Montalcino, Val d'Orcia & Cortona
best_period_window: Mid-May–late June & mid-September–late October
gateway_airport: FLR Florence Peretola, 55 min drive to Greve in Chianti; PSA Pisa 1 h 40 min; BLQ Bologna 1 h 55 min

title: Vilnius & Aukštaitija: Farmhouse Ale and Mead Road
best_period_window: May to October. September–October for mushroom season, honey harvest and the beer festivals; June for cold soup season and Rasos midsummer

title: Crémant and the Luxembourg Moselle
best_period_window: Whit Monday brings Grevenmacher's wine market and June the vines in full leaf; September is harvest, when the smallest domaines are hardest to reach.
gateway_airport: Luxembourg (LUX)

title: Underground Streets and Feteasca Neagră: A Week Through Codru and Ștefan Vodă
sub_region: Chișinău, the Codru hills, Ștefan Vodă and the southern Valul lui Traian
best_period_window: the last ten days of September through the first weekend of October (harvest, then Ziua Națională a Vinului)
gateway_airport: Chișinău International (KIV), 13 km southeast of the centre; trolleybus 30 and bus 165 run into town, a taxi is €8–€12 (150–230 MDL) — there is no published airport tariff and meters are not reliably used, so hail through Yandex Go or Bolt and take the quoted fixed fare, which lands around 160 MDL for the 25-minute run; pre-booked private transfers start near €49 per car, which is money thrown away. Overland: Iași (Romania) is 3 h by road, Odesa 4 h. There is a slow overnight train from Bucharest to Chișinău.

title: Vranec & Stanušina: The Tikveš Basin and the Vardar Road
sub_region: Tikveš & Povardarie — Kavadarci, Negotino, Demir Kapija, Štip & Skopje
best_period_window: Late April–mid-June & September–late October
gateway_airport: SKP Skopje, 1 h 20 min drive to Negotino, 1 h 35 min to Kavadarci; OHD Ohrid 2 h 30 min

title: Cheese, Genever and the North Holland Table
sub_region: North Holland and the Schiedam distilleries
best_period_window: The Alkmaar and Edam demonstration markets run April to September, and Hollandse Nieuwe herring reaches the stalls from late May or early June.
gateway_airport: Amsterdam Schiphol (AMS)

title: Solaris and Smoked Plums: A Małopolska Eating and Drinking Week from Kraków
best_period_window: the second half of September into the first ten days of October — *winobranie* harvest, plum-smoking in Szydłów, apples in Łącko and *oscypek* still coming off the Podhale pastures
gateway_airport: Kraków–Balice (KRK). The **SKA1** train runs airport → Kraków Główny in 20 minutes, **20 PLN** (~€4.70) one-way, luggage free.

title: Douro Field Blends: Quintas, Tawnies & the Pocinho Line
sub_region: Alto Douro Vinhateiro — Baixo Corgo, Cima Corgo & Douro Superior
best_period_window: Late April–mid-June & mid-September–end October
gateway_airport: OPO Porto Francisco Sá Carneiro, 1 h 45 min drive to Peso da Régua, 2 h 10 min to Pinhão

title: Fetească and Fire Water: A Week Through Dealu Mare and Drăgășani
sub_region: Dealu Mare (Prahova & Buzău), the Buzău Land Geopark, and Drăgășani on the Olt
best_period_window: mid-September to mid-October — the *culesul viilor* harvest, warm days, cellars open and working
gateway_airport: Bucharest Otopeni (OTP). Dealu Mare is 70–90 min north-east by road; Drăgășani 3 h west. Trains reach Ploiești and Drăgășani but not the cellars — this is a road trip with a hired driver.
currency: Romanian leu (RON) — roughly 5.0–5.3 RON to the euro during 2026

title: Skåne Wine Country: Österlen & Kullabygden
sub_region: Skåne — Österlen, Kullahalvön and the Malmö–Lund axis
best_period_window: Late May to early October. **Harvest is late September to mid-October** and is the most interesting time to visit a Swedish vineyard; June–August for apple blossom, long light and open coastal kitchens

title: Burja Country: Vipava's Zelen, Karst Teran & the Osmica Trail
sub_region: Vipava Valley, the Karst & eastern Goriška Brda
best_period_window: Late April–mid-June & September–early November
gateway_airport: TRS Trieste–Ronchi, 45 min to Štanjel and 55 min to Vipava; LJU Ljubljana 1 h 15 min; VCE Venice 1 h 50 min

title: Veltlínske and Furmint: The Small Carpathian Wine Route and Slovakia's Secret Tokaj
sub_region: Malokarpatská vinohradnícka oblasť and the Slovak Tokaj
best_period_window: mid-September to mid-October — harvest, burčiak on every square, and the November open-cellar weekend within reach
gateway_airport: Bratislava (BTS) or Vienna (VIE, 60 km, direct bus). Return from Košice (KSC). ZSSK regional trains Bratislava hl. st. → Pezinok in ~25 min, twice hourly.

title: Grandvalira & Pal-Arinsal: Andorra's Six-Sector Week
best_period_window: Mid-January–mid-March, with the second half of January the sweet spot for snow depth against crowds
gateway_airport: TLS Toulouse–Blagnac, 3 h–3 h 30 by road to Soldeu; BCN Barcelona El Prat, 3 h–3 h 45; LEU Andorra–La Seu d'Urgell, 45 min but almost no scheduled traffic

title: Ski Arlberg — St. Anton, the Flexenbahn and the Valluga
best_period_window: January and February hold the most reliable snow; March gives longer days but softer afternoon off-piste.
gateway_airport: Innsbruck (INN)

title: KitzSki — the Streif, the Tree Runs and Pass Thurn
best_period_window: Kitzbühel's low base altitude makes January and February the safer bet for reliable snow at valley level.
gateway_airport: Innsbruck (INN)

title: Jahorina & Bjelašnica: Sarajevo's Olympic Mountains in Winter
sub_region: Jahorina, Bjelašnica & Igman — the 1984 Olympic mountains above Sarajevo
best_period_window: Late January–early March, with the first three weeks of February the most reliable window for depth on both mountains
gateway_airport: SJJ Sarajevo International, 30 km / 45–60 min to Jahorina, 27 km / 40–50 min to Bjelašnica's Babin Do

title: Hautes Fagnes Cross-Country — and the Honest Plan B
best_period_window: Snow cover reliable enough for cross-country grooming is not guaranteed most winters: build this trip expecting a good chance of little or no skiable snow.
gateway_airport: Liège (LGG)

title: Bansko: Seven Days Under Todorka, Gondola Queue Included
sub_region: The Pirin, Blagoevgrad province — Bansko, Bunderishka Polyana and Dobrinishte
best_period_window: mid-January to mid-March — cold, settled snow on the north-facing upper mountain
gateway_airport: Sofia (SOF), 160 km north; road transfer 2 h 30–3 h via the E79 and Simitli. Bansko Express, the established airport shuttle, has published its **26 December 2026 – 22 March 2027** shared winter fares at **£25–£39 per person each way (roughly €29–€45)** depending on party size — cheapest at four or more, plus a £1 per person booking fee — and runs the shared service only for flights landing or leaving Sofia between 10:00 and 23:55. The public Sofia–Bansko coach is about **€17** and takes 2 h 45–3 h. Plovdiv (PDV) is 190 km east. The narrow-gauge Septemvri–Dobrinishte railway reaches Bansko slowly and beautifully, but not usefully with ski bags.
currency: Euro (EUR) — sole legal tender since 1 February 2026; mandatory dual BGN display ended 8 August 2026

title: Engelberg-Titlis: The Laub, Steinberg and Galtiberg Descents
best_period_window: The Titlis glacier holds snow all season; the Laub and Galtiberg exits lower down need a settled, well-bonded snowpack, best from late January.
gateway_airport: Zürich (ZRH)

title: Verbier and the 4 Vallées: Mont-Fort, Tortin and the Stairway to Heaven
best_period_window: The Mont-Fort glacier holds snow all season; the Tortin face and lower Verbier slopes need a genuine cold spell to ski well, best from mid-January.
gateway_airport: Geneva (GVA)

title: Krkonoše — Špindlerův Mlýn, Pec and the Ridge Tour
best_period_window: The ridge above 1,300 m holds a reliable base longest; valley snow at Špindlerův Mlýn is now heavily snowmaking-dependent by comparison.
gateway_airport: Prague (PRG)

title: Garmisch-Partenkirchen: The Classic Area and the Zugspitze Glacier
best_period_window: The Classic area sits low (750-2050 m) and is snow-dependent; the Zugspitze glacier above 2000 m holds snow reliably from December into April.
gateway_airport: Munich (MUC)

title: Baqueira Beret: Val d'Aran on the Atlantic Side
best_period_window: Mid-January–mid-March; the second half of February combines the deepest base with lengthening days
gateway_airport: TLS Toulouse–Blagnac, 2 h 30–3 h to Vielha via Bossòst; ILD Lleida–Alguaire 2 h 30; BCN Barcelona El Prat 4 h–4 h 30

title: Levi & Ylläs: Lapland Twin-Resort Ski Week
best_period_window: Late November to early May. **February–April is the sweet spot** — returning daylight, deep cold-dry snow and long cross-country conditions. December is dark (the sun barely clears the horizon at this latitude); late April gives spring skiing with 18 hours of light

title: Chamonix Freeride: Grands Montets, Vallée Blanche and the Off-Piste Circuit
best_period_window: February and March give the most stable glacier crossings; January can be colder but the Vallée Blanche moraine exit is icier.
gateway_airport: Geneva (GVA)

title: Les 3 Vallées from Méribel — Courchevel to Val Thorens
best_period_window: February and March give the most reliable snow across all altitudes; late-season March offers longer light for the Val Thorens and Orelle sectors.
gateway_airport: Chambéry (CMF)

title: Parnassos & Arachova: Skiing Above the Oracle
sub_region: Mount Parnassos, Arachova & Delphi, Central Greece
best_period_window: Late January–late February, the only weeks in which Parnassos can be relied on to have both sectors open
gateway_airport: ATH Athens Eleftherios Venizelos, 200 km / 2 h 30–3 h to Arachova; the ski centre is a further 27 km / 35–45 min above the town

title: Sellaronda Week: Alta Badia & Val Gardena on One Pass
sub_region: Alta Badia & Val Gardena, Dolomites, South Tyrol
best_period_window: Mid-January–mid-March; late February and early March give the longest lift days with the Sellaronda still comfortably completable
gateway_airport: VCE Venice Marco Polo, 2 h 45–3 h 15 to Corvara; VRN Verona 3 h–3 h 30; INN Innsbruck 2 h–2 h 30 over the Brenner

title: Malbun and Steg: A Small Alpine Basin Done Properly
best_period_window: Malbun's basin holds snow well into March, but its total lift-served terrain is small; the plan below leans on day trips for variety.
gateway_airport: Zürich (ZRH)

title: Hemsedal & Hallingdal: Alpine and Nordic
best_period_window: Late November to early May. **February to mid-April** is the core: reliable base, returning light and the best ski-touring conditions. December and January are dark and very cold; late April brings spring corn snow

title: Kasprowy and the Snow Cannons: A Podhale Ski Week from Zakopane to Białka
sub_region: Podhale — Zakopane, the Polish Tatras and the Białka valley
best_period_window: the second half of January and the first half of March — cold nights for the snow guns, and the school holidays either side of you
gateway_airport: Kraków–Balice (KRK), then the Zakopianka — 2 h by transfer or bus on a good day, 3 h 30+ on a winter Saturday. Trains Kraków–Zakopane run around 3 h.

title: Postăvarul and the Bucegi: A Ski Week on the Prahova Valley
sub_region: Postăvarul massif and the Prahova Valley, Brașov & Prahova counties
best_period_window: mid-January to late February — coldest air, best snowmaking window, full lift operation
gateway_airport: Bucharest Otopeni (OTP). Train Bucharest Nord → Brașov, then bus 20 to Poiana Brașov. Sinaia is on the same line, 1 h 40 from Bucharest. Driving means the DN1 — see the warning below.
currency: Romanian leu (RON) — roughly 5.0–5.3 RON to the euro during 2026

title: Kopaonik: Pančićev Vrh, the Karaman Ridge and a Week on Serbia's Roof
sub_region: Kopaonik National Park & Raška, southern Serbia
best_period_window: Late January–early March; the second half of February combines the deepest base with the famous Kopaonik sun
gateway_airport: BEG Belgrade Nikola Tesla, 285 km / 4 h 30–6 h by road; INI Niš Constantine the Great, 200 km / 3 h 30–4 h 30 and usually the smarter arrival

title: Åre: Sweden's Lift-Linked Winter Capital
best_period_window: Early December to early May. **March and April** are the best weeks — long light, deep base, spring sun and the resort's biggest events; February is coldest and reliably snowy; December is dark but festive

title: Kranjska Gora, Vogel & Krvavec: A Julian Alps Ski Week
sub_region: Julian Alps & Gorenjska — Kranjska Gora, Planica, Bohinj and the Kamnik-Savinja fringe
best_period_window: Mid-January–early March, with February the only month all four ski areas reliably run their full lift fleets
gateway_airport: LJU Ljubljana Jože Pučnik, 60 km / 50 min to Kranjska Gora, 8 km to the Krvavec cable car, 65 km / 1 h to Bohinj; VCE Venice Marco Polo 3 h and KLU Klagenfurt 1 h 30 as alternates

title: Chopok Both Sides: A Jasná Week with the High Tatras Attached
sub_region: Nízke Tatry (Demänovská dolina and Chopok Juh) with the High Tatras at Tatranská Lomnica and Štrbské Pleso
best_period_window: late January to mid-March — the coldest, deepest, most reliable stretch on both aspects of Chopok
gateway_airport: Poprad-Tatry (TAT) is 70 km east of Jasná, about an hour on the D1; Bratislava (BTS) is 300 km, 3 h; Kraków (KRK) is 200 km north over the border. Rail: the InterCity to Liptovský Mikuláš, then bus or taxi 12 km up Demänovská dolina.

title: Pelicans, Beech and Bujtina: Eastern Albania Off the Grid
best_period_window: Mid-May–late June & September–mid-October
gateway_airport: TIA Tirana, 2 h 30 to Korçë via Elbasan and 1 h 40 to Librazhd; OHD Ohrid (North Macedonia), 50 min to Pogradec via the Qafë Thanë border

title: A Self-Catering Week in the Gesäuse Gorge
sub_region: Gesäuse National Park, Ennstal Alps, Styria
best_period_window: The Alm access track is unploughed and closed by snow from roughly late October to April; June evenings are still cold enough for the wood stove.
gateway_airport: Graz (GRZ)

title: The Una's Green Water: Cabins, Travertine and Krajina Forest
best_period_window: Late May–early July & September–mid-October
gateway_airport: ZAG Zagreb, 2 h 30 to Bihać via the Maljevac crossing; ZAD Zadar 2 h 45; SJJ Sarajevo 4 h 30

title: Heathland Week — Cabin Days in the Hoge Kempen
sub_region: Hoge Kempen National Park, Belgian Limburg
best_period_window: Late May–June brings breeding nightjars and orchids on the heath; August turns the Mechelse Heide purple with flowering heather.
gateway_airport: Brussels (BRU)

title: Reserve Country: Central Balkan Huts, Karst Caves and the Rhodope Vulture Gorges
sub_region: Central Balkan National Park (Stara Planina), the Lovech karst, and the Eastern Rhodopes
best_period_window: late May to mid-June (waterfalls at full flow, vultures on eggs, meadows in flower)
gateway_airport: Sofia (SOF) or Plovdiv (PDV). Kalofer is 2 h from Sofia on the A1/I-6 via Karlovo. Finish near the Greek border: Madzharovo is 3 h 30 from Sofia, 2 h 15 from Plovdiv. Hire the car at the airport.
currency: Euro (EUR) — sole legal tender since 1 February 2026; mandatory dual BGN display ended 8 August 2026

title: Stay on the Path: A Week in the Swiss National Park
best_period_window: Chamanna Cluozza opens roughly mid-June to mid-October only; the Val Trupchun red deer rut in September draws the heaviest foot traffic of the year.
gateway_airport: Zurich (ZRH)

title: Praděd Country — A Chata Week in the Jeseníky
sub_region: Jeseníky (Hrubý Jeseník), Moravian-Silesian and Olomouc Regions
best_period_window: The Ovčárna access road can be affected by early or late-season snow outside June–September; the Velká kotlina flora reserve is at its richest in July.
gateway_airport: Ostrava (OSR)

title: Bog and Wildwood — A Week in the Šumava Core
best_period_window: Capercaillie leks close parts of the core zone in April–May at dawn; October brings the best chance of hearing red deer roar in the Modrava basin, and biting insects drop off by then.
gateway_airport: Prague (PRG)

title: Let It Be Wild: A Week in the Bayerischer Wald
best_period_window: Deep snow closes the high trails December to April; July and August bring the biggest crowds and the worst midge hatches in the lowland bogs.
gateway_airport: Munich (MUC)

title: Dehesa, Vultures and Dark Sky: An Extremadura Slow Week
sub_region: Monfragüe, Las Hurdes, Sierra de Gata & the Jerte
best_period_window: Mid-March–mid-May & late September–early November
gateway_airport: MAD Madrid-Barajas, 2 h 30 to Torrejón el Rubio; SVQ Seville 2 h 45; LIS Lisbon 3 h 15

title: Saimaa Lakeland: Linnansaari & Kolovesi Cabin Week
sub_region: Lake Saimaa, South Savo — Linnansaari and Kolovesi National Parks
best_period_window: Mid-June to early September for paddling and swimming; **late August–September for mushrooms, berries and mist mornings**; February–March for ice, snowshoeing and a frozen lake outside the sauna door

title: Suðuroy & Mykines: Faroese Isolation Week
best_period_window: **Mid-May to late August** — the Mykines ferry and the puffin colony operate only in this window. September gives the clearest air and the emptiest villages but Mykines access closes

title: Hautes-Chaumes — A Marcairie Week on the Vosges Crest
sub_region: Parc naturel régional des Ballons des Vosges, Haut-Rhin
best_period_window: Marcairies and fermes-auberges on the hautes-chaumes generally open only from late May to October, when cattle are up on summer pasture.
gateway_airport: Bâle-Mulhouse-Freiburg (EAP/BSL/MLH)

title: Velebit Stone and Lika Forest: A Karst Cabin Week
best_period_window: Mid-June–mid-July & early September–mid-October
gateway_airport: ZAD Zadar, 55 min to Starigrad-Paklenica and 2 h 05 to Krasno; RJK Rijeka 2 h 10 to Krasno; ZAG Zagreb 2 h 40

title: Puszta, Karst and Szer: A Week in Hungary's Three Quietest National Parks
best_period_window: mid-October to early November for the crane migration — the single best wildlife spectacle in Hungary
gateway_airport: Budapest Ferenc Liszt (BUD). A car is effectively required — the Őrség hamlets and the Aggtelek villages have one or two buses a day, and the puszta has none.

title: Limestone, Juniper and Pinnetta Smoke: A Supramonte Week
best_period_window: Late April–early June & mid-September–late October
gateway_airport: OLB Olbia, 1 h 45 to Oliena and 2 h 15 to Urzulei; CAG Cagliari 2 h 30 to Baunei; AHO Alghero is the natural exit, 50 min from Bosa

title: Lakeshore and Forest: A Week in the Upper Sûre
best_period_window: July–August bring the busiest lake weekends; the Nature Park's dark-sky programme runs its main season September to March, on the longer, clearer nights.
gateway_airport: Luxembourg (LUX)

title: Gauja & Slītere: Latvian Forest Cabin Week
sub_region: Gauja National Park (Vidzeme) and Slītere National Park / Livonian Coast (northern Kurzeme)
best_period_window: **Late April–May for the bird migration at Cape Kolka**, June for long light and river paddling, **September–October for mushrooms and the best foliage in the Baltics**

title: Limestone, Floodplain and Well Water: Seven Quiet Days in Rural Moldova
sub_region: The Răut Canyon, the Dniester Cliffs & the Prut Floodplain
best_period_window: mid-May to late June, then mid-September to mid-October
gateway_airport: Chișinău International (KIV), 13 km from the centre; overland by bus or rail from Iași or Odesa. Hire a car at KIV — rural buses run on farm timetables and will not fit this route.

title: Katun Smoke and Lynx Country: A Šar–Mavrovo–Galičica Cabin Week
best_period_window: Late June–mid-July & early September–early October
gateway_airport: SKP Skopje, 1 h 50 to Mavrovi Anovi and 1 h 10 to Popova Šapka; OHD Ohrid, 25 min to the Galičica gate and 2 h 15 to Mavrovo

title: Wet Heath and Dark Sky: A Week in Drenthe
best_period_window: Ground-nesting birds close several heath paths mid-March to mid-August; late September onward gives the longest, darkest nights for stargazing.
gateway_airport: Amsterdam Schiphol (AMS)

title: White Bicycles: A Week on the Veluwe
best_period_window: September and October bring the red deer rut and the best light in the sculpture garden; midsummer weekends see the longest queues at the park gates.
gateway_airport: Amsterdam Schiphol (AMS)

title: Połoniny and Dark Skies: Seven Off-Grid Days in the Bieszczady
sub_region: The Bieszczady & the San Valley, Podkarpackie
best_period_window: late May to late June, then mid-September to mid-October
gateway_airport: Fly Rzeszów–Jasionka (RZE); 150 km / 2 h 45 min via DK84 and DW894. Kraków (KRK) is 300 km / 4 h 30 min. Rail reaches only Zagórz or Ustrzyki Dolne; the last 40–60 km needs a car.

title: Granite, Granaries and Wolf Country: Peneda-Gerês Slow Week
best_period_window: Mid-May–late June & mid-September–late October
gateway_airport: OPO Porto Francisco Sá Carneiro, 1 h 20 to Vilar da Veiga (Gerês), 1 h 35 to Soajo, 2 h 05 to Pitões das Júnias

title: Karst and Wooden Spires: Apuseni and Maramureș from a Cabin
sub_region: Apuseni Nature Park (Bihor/Alba) and Maramureș (Iza, Vaser and the Rodna foothills)
best_period_window: the second half of September — hay in, berries and mushrooms up, forest roads dry, bears still active but crowds gone
gateway_airport: Cluj-Napoca (CLJ) is the airport for both halves — Apuseni is 2 h west, Maramureș 3 h north. Baia Mare (BAY) is closer to Maramureș but has far thinner flights.
currency: Romanian leu (RON) — roughly 5.0–5.3 RON to the euro during 2026

title: Ladders in the Waterfall: A Cabin Week in Slovenský raj and on Muránska planina
sub_region: Slovenský raj National Park and Muránska planina
best_period_window: the first half of September — gorges open, water low, the summer crowds gone from the Suchá Belá ladders
gateway_airport: Poprad-Tatry (TAT), 35 km to Hrabušice; Košice (KSC) 95 km. Rail to Spišská Nová Ves, then a regional bus to Hrabušice-Podlesok — but a car is close to essential for the Muráň half.

title: Clear Water, Thin Rescue: Kayak and Freedive the Albanian Riviera
sub_region: Albanian Riviera & Karaburun-Sazan Marine National Park
best_period_window: Early June and the whole of September — warm sea, settled maestral afternoons, operators fully staffed, and none of the August traffic
gateway_airport: TIA Tirana Nënë Tereza — 2 h 30 to Vlorë, 4 h 15 to Himarë, 5 h to Sarandë. CFU Corfu plus the Corfu–Sarandë ferry (30–70 min) is often faster for the southern half of the trip.

title: Sailing and Windsurfing the Salzkammergut Lakes
best_period_window: The Rosenwind thermal is most reliable from late June to early September; June water is still cold, September brings the steadiest afternoons and thinner crowds.
gateway_airport: Salzburg (SZG)

title: Kitesurfing and Land Yachting at De Panne
best_period_window: May, June and September carry the steadiest south-westerlies with fewer bathing-zone restrictions than the peak July–August holiday weeks.
gateway_airport: Brussels (BRU)

title: Sailing the Belgian Coast, Ostend to Nieuwpoort
sub_region: West and East Flanders, Belgian Coast
best_period_window: May and June bring the steadiest moderate south-westerlies; July and August add reliable afternoon sea breeze but busier shipping traffic and marina berths.
gateway_airport: Brussels (BRU)

title: Wind, Cliff and Reedbed: The Bulgarian Black Sea from Durankulak to Rezovo
sub_region: The Bulgarian Black Sea Coast — Dobrudzha to Strandzha
best_period_window: the first three weeks of June, then the whole of September
gateway_airport: Fly into Varna, out of Burgas; 130 km apart, both served by low-cost carriers. Hire a car — the E87 / Route 9 coast road is the spine and the northern kite beaches have no useful bus.
currency: Euro (EUR) — sole legal tender since 1 February 2026; mandatory dual BGN display ended 8 August 2026

title: Rügen and Fehmarn: A Baltic Wind Week
best_period_window: June and September bring the most reliable westerlies; July and August add the warmest water but more midday lulls between the thermal and the gradient wind.
gateway_airport: Hamburg Airport (HAM)

title: Cold Hawaii: Klitmøller, Vorupør & Thy
sub_region: Thy, northwest Jutland, North Sea coast
best_period_window: **September to early November and March to May** — the wind statistics are best either side of summer and the water is still workable. June–August is warmest and least windy, which suits beginners and SUP; midwinter is for the committed only

title: West Estonian Coast: Pärnu, Ristna & Sõrve
sub_region: Pärnu Bay, Hiiumaa and Saaremaa, West Estonian Archipelago
best_period_window: **June to September for warm water and thermals; late September to November for the autumn storm swell** that makes Ristna Estonia's real surf season. Winter brings ice-surfing photos and very few participants

title: Two Winds, One Town: Kiting Tarifa and the Costa de la Luz
sub_region: Cádiz — Tarifa, the Strait of Gibraltar & the Costa de la Luz
best_period_window: Late April–June and mid-September–October — reliable wind, warm-enough water, and beach zoning not yet at its most restrictive
gateway_airport: GIB Gibraltar 45 min by road; JEZ Jerez 1 h 20; AGP Málaga 1 h 45–2 h 15; SVQ Seville 2 h 15. GIB is closest but has the thinnest schedule — most people fly AGP and drive the A-7/N-340.

title: A Surf Week in Hossegor, Seignosse and Capbreton
best_period_window: September and October bring the biggest, most consistent groundswell with warm water and thinner crowds than the August peak; June offers smaller, friendlier surf for building confidence.
gateway_airport: Biarritz (BIA)

title: Quiberon and the Golfe du Morbihan by Board and Kayak
best_period_window: July and August bring the most reliable thermal afternoon breeze on the Côte Sauvage; June and September keep the Golfe's currents just as strong with far fewer boats.
gateway_airport: Nantes Atlantique (NTE)

title: Meltemi Weeks: Paros & Naxos on Board and Kite
best_period_window: Mid-June–mid-September for wind; late May and late September for wind plus swimmable calm
gateway_airport: JTR is wrong for this trip — use PAS Paros National (seasonal Athens and limited European) 20 min to Golden Beach, JNX Naxos Island National 10 min to Naxos Town, or ATH Athens + Blue Star ferry to Paros 3 h 45 min / Naxos 4 h 30 min

title: Maestral Country: Sailing and Sea-Kayaking Central Dalmatia
sub_region: Central Dalmatia — Split, Brač, Hvar & the Pakleni Islands, Vis, Šolta
best_period_window: Late May–late June and early September–early October — reliable maestral, warm sea, no August berth war
gateway_airport: SPU Split, 25 min to ACI Marina Split and 30 min to ACI Marina Trogir; ferry Split–Supetar (Brač) 50 min

title: No Coast, Two Seas: Sailing Balaton and Paddling the Tisza Flooded Forest
sub_region: Lake Balaton, Lake Tisza, the Szigetköz Danube branches and Lake Velence
best_period_window: the first three weeks of June and the first two weeks of September — water still 21–24 °C, wind reliable, shores empty
gateway_airport: Budapest Ferenc Liszt (BUD). MÁV line 29 from Déli/Kelenföld to Balatonfüred, ~2 h; line 30 to Siófok on the south shore. Lake Tisza is 2 h by car from Budapest on the M3; rail to Tiszafüred via Füzesabony.

title: The Bonifacio Funnel: Porto Pollo, La Maddalena and Gallura on the Wind
sub_region: Northern Sardinia — Gallura, Porto Pollo & the La Maddalena Archipelago
best_period_window: Mid-May–June and September — the maestrale is at its most reliable, the water is swimmable, and the archipelago is not yet rationed by August boat traffic
gateway_airport: OLB Olbia Costa Smeralda — 45 min to Palau and Porto Pollo, 1 h to Santa Teresa Gallura, 25 min to Porto San Paolo for Tavolara. AHO Alghero is 2 h 15.

title: Curonian Lagoon: Svencelė & Nida Kite Week
sub_region: Curonian Lagoon and the Baltic coast, Klaipėda region
best_period_window: **May to early October.** May–June and September have the strongest and most consistent wind; July–August is warmest with reliable afternoon thermals and the busiest water

title: Monaco Water Week: Freediving and Sea Kayak to Menton
sub_region: Monaco and the Alpes-Maritimes coast, Cap d'Ail to Menton
best_period_window: Water is warmest and most freedive-friendly from July to September; June has clearer visibility and fewer tourist boats over the Posidonia meadows.
gateway_airport: Nice Côte d'Azur (NCE)

title: Monaco Sailing Week: Port Hercule to the Riviera
sub_region: Monaco and the French-Italian Riviera coast
best_period_window: May, June, September and October carry the most reliable thermal sea breeze without August's crowding; July and August are sailable but Port Hercule and Villefranche get very busy.
gateway_airport: Nice Côte d'Azur (NCE)

title: Fjord and Sandbar: Kayaking Boka Kotorska, Kiting Ada Bojana
sub_region: Boka Kotorska (Bay of Kotor), the Ulcinj coast & Lake Skadar
best_period_window: Early June and September — the maestral is settled, the bay is warm and glassy in the mornings, the Ada Bojana kite schools are fully staffed, and Kotor is not yet a cruise-ship queue
gateway_airport: TIV Tivat — 25 min to Kotor, 1 h 45 to Ulcinj. TGD Podgorica is 1 h 30 to Kotor and 1 h 20 to Ulcinj, and closer to Lake Skadar. DBV Dubrovnik is 2 h to Kotor but crosses an EU external border.

title: Skûtsjes and Open Boats on the Frisian Lakes
sub_region: Friesland lake district and the IJsselmeer
best_period_window: July and August coincide with the SKS skûtsjesilen racing calendar between the lake towns; May, June and September give quieter water and steadier south-westerlies.
gateway_airport: Amsterdam Schiphol (AMS)

title: The Brouwersdam Kite and Wing Foil Week
best_period_window: May, June and September carry the most consistent south-westerlies without the July-August crowding; late autumn adds storm-force wind for experienced sailors only.
gateway_airport: Rotterdam The Hague Airport (RTM)

title: Flat Water and Side-Shore: Masurian Sailing and a Kite Week on the Hel Peninsula
sub_region: Great Masurian Lakes and the Hel Peninsula / Zatoka Pucka
best_period_window: the second half of June — long days, warm bay water, and wind before the August lull
gateway_airport: Warsaw (WAW/WMI) → Giżycko by train via Olsztyn/Korsze, 4–5 h. Gdańsk (GDN) is the exit airport: SKM/PKM to Gdynia, then the Hel line train down the peninsula, ~1 h 45.

title: Reserve and Peninsula: Surfing Ericeira, Peniche and the Nazaré Canyon
sub_region: Estremadura — Ericeira World Surfing Reserve, Peniche & Nazaré
best_period_window: Mid-September–end October — the best swell-to-weather ratio of the year, warm water, and the nortada already easing; May–June is the calm, beginner-friendly alternative
gateway_airport: LIS Lisbon Humberto Delgado — 45 min to Ericeira, 1 h 20 to Peniche, 1 h 45 to Nazaré. OPO Porto is 2 h 15 to Nazaré if you run the trip in reverse.

title: Reedbeds and Rip Currents: The Danube Delta and the Romanian Coast by Paddle
sub_region: The Danube Delta & the Dobrogea Coast
best_period_window: mid-May to mid-June for birds and tolerable mosquitoes, then all of September
gateway_airport: Bucharest Otopeni (OTP) to Tulcea is 260 km / 4 h by road or coach; Constanța (CND) has seasonal flights [VERIFY: current CND seasonal routes]. Go carless for the delta half and pick up a hire car in Tulcea or Constanța for the coast.
